description: Two native-validated filament-speed regressions, each killed by its direct motion oracle and the full SEMM Print export. Zero cooling/stamping boundaries remain incomplete.

selection.existing_known_broken_case: Zero tower interface purge length removes only interface tower material

mutants.intended_failed_case: Loading zero speeds inherit the active modal feed and positive rates remain observable
mutants.description: Turn only zero loading speed into 1 mm/s. The zero row should omit new feed tokens and inherit the explicit 12 mm/s start feed for both XY loading moves.

mutants.intended_failed_case: Stamping speed at the lowest positive rate reaches its physical return strokes
mutants.description: Clamp the configured positive 1 mm/s stamping edge to 2 mm/s while preserving the 20 mm/s control. The two physical E/XY return strokes must no longer derive to 1 mm/s.

deferred_zero_boundaries.filament_cooling_initial_speed: Keep registered min0 unclaimed: the consumer divides by this speed; only positive 1 mm/s and 2 mm/s controls are tested.
deferred_zero_boundaries.filament_cooling_final_speed: Keep registered min0 unclaimed: the consumer divides by this speed and prior zero-final evidence serialized F0; only positive 1 mm/s and 2 mm/s controls are tested.
deferred_zero_boundaries.filament_stamping_loading_speed: Keep registered min0 unclaimed: the stamping movement divides by this speed; only positive 1 mm/s and 20 mm/s controls are tested.
